title: sorghum pseudoischaemum
intro: Sorghum pseudoischaemum, commonly known as Chinese sorghum or broomcorn, is a plant species that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant has been used in traditional Chinese medicine to treat various health conditions, such as fever, rheumatism, and gastrointestinal issues. The health benefits of Sorghum pseudoischaemum include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and lower blood sugar levels. The bioactive constituents of the plant, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
